subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select 'no improvement required'.**

His tone was neither of anger __nor sorrow.__
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'nor of sorrow.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in Part (nor sorrow) of the sentence.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is incorrect.
 
• Here **'sorrow'** is an **abstract noun** and it is **related to the tone** of the subject.
 
• So we have to **add a preposition 'of'** before the abstract noun.
 
• **'Of'** is used to indicate relating to, belonging to; to indicate reference, or to specify the number or an amount.
 
• **Another example:**
 
 
• *This bat is made up **of **Kashmiri willow wood.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'nor sorrow' in the sentence should be replaced with 'nor of sorrow' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence:__ *His tone was neither of anger **__nor of sorrow.__***
